summary: For an empty pattern graph, subgraph_isomorphisms_iter repeatedly returns Some([]) because isomorphisms immediately returns the already-complete mapping without advancing state. The fix moves this case into GraphMatcher, whose iterator consumes the empty mapping once using Option::take and then returns None. The reversal restores the parent implementation of isomorphisms and GraphMatcher while preserving the regression test added in tests/iso.rs. No tests were executed.
expected_failure:
assertion `left == right` failed
  left: Some([])
 right: None
